native.support_gap_note: Requested Z distance is a slicer setting. Native layer quantization changes the commanded separation to the nominal roof underside. Strand-flow thickness, sag, removal and finish remain separate physical observations.

lettering_reading.scope: Positive native model centerlines in CAD marking windows. XY labels exclude nominal slabs touching the body face; side labels exclude centerlines inside the plain side face. Path retention does not establish physical legibility.

recessed_identity_reading.scope: Negative-space underside identity review. Actual STL bed-section channels are compared with positive native road centerlines buffered by half their commanded width on the open recess layers. Coverage is a nominal strand-width footprint, not physical bead shape, recess depth or legibility.

source_profile_reading.scope: Native positive extrusion moves attributed to standalone source objects or shared assembly objects. Model nozzle-Z steps, strand-flow heights, wall-lane counts, commanded wall feeds and feature order are observed separately from requested 3MF options. Per-layer feature sequences can contain multiple islands; first-wall order does not qualify every island. Physical bead shape, infill overlap, surface and strength are unmeasured.

captive_release_reading.scope: Native model-to-model contacts in the preserved print-assembly frame. Nominal bottom surfaces are first model nozzle Z minus the actual shared object model Z step; top surfaces are last model nozzle Z. Bridge strand-flow height is reported separately. Gap-window deposits exclude the exact contact planes. Lateral air subtracts half of each commanded line width from measured centerline separation. Travel is the supplied geometric stroke, not observed physical motion. These commanded slabs and strand-width footprints do not measure bead shape, sag, physical clearance, release force or reliable motion.
